features.title: Projects: create / list, unique name
features.user_visible_behavior: POST /api/v1/projects creates a project (201); a duplicate name returns 409; GET /api/v1/projects lists projects by id.

features.title: Task CRUD
features.user_visible_behavior: Tasks can be created under a project, read, patched and deleted; priority must be 1-5.

features.title: Filter tasks by status and max priority
features.user_visible_behavior: GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/tasks?status=todo&max_priority=2 returns matching tasks; filters combine with AND; max_priority is inclusive.

features.title: Due dates + ?overdue=true filter
features.user_visible_behavior: Tasks have an optional timezone-aware due_at; GET .../tasks?overdue=true returns tasks whose due_at is in the past and that are not done.
features.notes: Needs migration 0002 (write-migration skill). Built human-in-the-loop (topic 6): see stages/04-scope-human-in-the-loop/approval-checklist.md.

features.title: Task tags
features.user_visible_behavior: Tasks can carry tags; tags are created on first use; GET .../tasks?tag=x filters by tag.
features.notes: Spec-driven (topic 7): specs/F05-task-tags.md. Needs a new table + migration.

features.title: Pagination on list endpoints
features.user_visible_behavior: List endpoints accept limit/offset and return {items,total,limit,offset} as defined in docs/api-conventions.md.
